name: offerwall-firebase-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Firebase (2nd gen) for the Moonetix offerwall: signed link callable and a postback that credits each transaction once.

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-moonetix "node --test test/emulator.test.ts"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-moonetix
